decided: A program is not finished, and its brief is not saved or offered for sign-off, while any open work still belongs to it: an active change, or an exploration that has not been concluded, even one filed under a stage the program does not declare or under no stage. A concluded exploration does not hold it.
alternatives: count only active changes, so an open exploration filed under a stage the program does not declare would not stop the program from being called finished
look only at the declared stages, so open work filed elsewhere would not stop the program from being called finished
why: The user should sign a program only when none of its work is still open, and an open exploration says more work is coming; a declared stage already counts an open exploration as unfinished, so open work under an undeclared stage is treated the same way.
